Assign exactly eight persistent tracks to sampled nonzero public 3-byte local appearance signatures, only when a current appearance and the immediately previous frame are uniquely matched one-to-one; duplicate or absent matches are UNKNOWN (no privileged identity assumption). Deterministic first-free/lowest-age eviction. Each track holds 6 actions x 2 saturating uint16 observed post-action public change counters; at count 65535 halve both counts by floor division before increment. For a tracked input/action with at least four observed authentic consequences, the preaction prediction is 0.5*S1_original + 0.5*(1+successes)/(2+successes+failures); otherwise S1_original. Update counters ONLY after authentic original env.step outcome. Reset ephemeral correspondence at episode boundaries but retain bounded learned action-consequence counts; test exact cold restore. Track labels are PUBLIC appearance associations, not ground-truth object IDs or an assumption of physical object permanence.
